name: reader.helmChart
doc: Reads a Helm chart folder, read-only: `Chart.yaml`, `Chart.lock`, the values files with every scalar as written, `values.schema.json`, the CRDs, the templates line by line with the values each condition and reference resolves to in the default values, the named templates they include, and the charts under `charts/`. It never writes and plans no change. Its fixtures are recorded with the Helm chart's cases (spec 035, T080, T081).
